[SWS_DM_00224] Indicator healing
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04204
⌈
If any indicator is configured, the DM shall set at the end of an operation cycle the
UDS
DTC status bit
7 (WarningIndicatorRequested) to 0, if the following conditions are
fulfilled:
• at least one healingCycleCounterThreshold is greater than 0
• all respective indicator healing cycle counters, which count the number of tested
and passed healing OperationCycles, have reached their healingCycleCoun-
terThreshold
⌋
